newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 5.875 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 5.875 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended February 1 was 5,875,219 gallons compared with 6,500,506 gallons last week.
Imports were 301,991 gallons compared with 860,710 gallons the previous week.
There were 6,757 domestic receipts this week compared to none the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,096,239 gallons, while bulk movement was 4,400,389 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 46,279,056 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 117,383,106 gallons.
